a.lede: Techies are building technology that can advance all aspects of the world — but can they protect their hearts? That's the vulnerability that honey pots exploit.
a.title: Experts warn: Nearly everyone in AI is susceptible to a honey-trap scheme right now

b.lede: The British cyber agency says that "building strong foundations has never mattered more" as AI hacking tools rely on exploiting simple security flaws.
b.title: UK warns AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing years of weak security
